description.ja: 正円を描く。中心と半径で配置される。
description.en: Draws a true circle, placed by its center and radius.

description.ja: 横に長い円を描く（幅と高さは 5:3）。縦長を添えると縦に長くなる。
description.en: Draws a circle stretched sideways, 5:3 wide to high. Tall turns it upright.

description.ja: 頂点を上にした三角を描く。
description.en: Draws a triangle with its apex at the top.

description.ja: 正方形を描く。縦長・横長を添えると長方形になる。
description.en: Draws a square. Tall or wide makes it a rectangle.

description.ja: 始点から終点へ、まっすぐな線を引く。
description.en: Draws a straight line from its start to its end.

description.ja: 円周の一部を描く。半円・三日月を添えると、その形の弧になる。
description.en: Draws part of a circle's rim. Semicircle or crescent gives the arc that form.

description.ja: 始点と終点のあいだを、直線・円弧・自由な曲がりをつないだ道筋で引く。道筋は描くたびに組み直す。
description.en: Draws the path between its two ends from straight runs, arcs and free bends, built anew at each drawing.

description.ja: 塗った小さな丸を置く（直径は画面の短い辺の約 1.2%）。向きと揺れの語は効かない。
description.en: Places a small filled dot, about 1.2% of the frame's short side across. Angle and sway words do not apply.

description.ja: 輪郭がゆるく膨らみ、ところどころくびれる閉じた形を描く。輪郭は描くたびに決まる。
description.en: Draws a closed form whose outline swells and pinches here and there, decided anew at each drawing.

description.ja: 頂点を上にした正多角形を描く。五角形が既定で、六角形〜八角形とも書ける。
description.en: Draws a regular polygon with a vertex at the top: five sides by default, or six to eight when written.

description.ja: 円の半分の弧を描く。
description.en: Draws an arc of half a circle.

description.ja: 細い三日月の形を描く。
description.en: Draws a thin crescent moon.

description.ja: 0度の向き。線なら横線として扱う。
description.en: A 0-degree orientation. A line is read as horizontal.

description.ja: 90度の向き。線なら縦線として扱う。
description.en: A 90-degree orientation. A line is read as vertical.

description.ja: 45 度・135 度・225 度・315 度のどれかに傾ける。
description.en: Tilts the form to one of 45, 135, 225 or 315 degrees.

description.ja: 左下から右上へ、23〜37 度上がる傾きにする。
description.en: Tilts the form up to the right by 23 to 37 degrees.

description.ja: 左上から右下へ、23〜37 度下がる傾きにする。
description.en: Tilts the form down to the right by 23 to 37 degrees.

description.ja: 右下から左上へ、23〜37 度上がる傾きにする。線は右下がりの線と同じに見え、始点と終点が入れ替わる。
description.en: Tilts the form up to the left by 23 to 37 degrees. A line looks like a falling line with its start and end swapped.

description.ja: 右上から左下へ、23〜37 度下がる傾きにする。線は右上がりの線と同じに見え、始点と終点が入れ替わる。
description.en: Tilts the form down to the left by 23 to 37 degrees. A line looks like a rising line with its start and end swapped.

description.ja: 形全体を中心まわりに回す。角度は、45 度の倍数から 6 度以上離れた所から選ぶ。
description.en: Turns the whole form about its center, to an angle at least 6 degrees away from any multiple of 45.

physical_description.ja: 揺らぎがほとんどない、細かな線の痕。
physical_description.en: A fine line trace with almost no sway.

description.ja: 非常に細く、筆致の変化をほぼ抑えた線。
description.en: A very thin line with almost no variation in touch.

physical_description.ja: 連続的に揺らぐ線に、薄い副線と微細な粒が残る。
physical_description.en: A continuously swaying line with faint secondary traces and fine grain.

description.ja: 幅と横揺れが連動し、細かな副線と紙目の粒を伴う。
description.en: Width and lateral sway move together, with fine secondary strokes and paper grain.

physical_description.ja: インクの線の痕。わずかなむらがあり、均一で硬い製図線にもなる。
physical_description.en: An ink line trace with slight variation; it can also be a uniform, hard drafting line.

description.ja: 明瞭さを保ちながら、わずかな幅と軌道の変化を持つ。
description.en: Stays clear while varying slightly in width and path.

physical_description.ja: 色の粉や蝋の擦れに、かすれと細かな隙間、粒状の欠けが残る。
physical_description.en: Colored powdery or waxy rubbing with scratchiness, fine gaps, and granular breaks.

description.ja: 幅の崩れ、途切れ、粉状の粒を含む淡い線。
description.en: A pale line with broken width, gaps, and powdery grain.

physical_description.ja: 蝋と油の不透明な色を厚く擦り重ね、短い運びの跡と紙の目が残る。
physical_description.en: Opaque waxy, oily color rubbed on thickly, leaving short stroke marks and the paper's tooth.

description.ja: 紙の目が抜ける縁と、詰まった芯の二層で引く、蝋の不透明な線。
description.en: An opaque waxy line in two layers: an edge where the paper's tooth shows through and a dense core.

physical_description.ja: 水で溶いた不透明な色が、つやの無い平らな塗りに乾き、筆の濃淡と擦れた副線が残る。
physical_description.en: Opaque water-based color that dries to a flat, matte coat, with brush tonal variation and rubbed secondary lines.

description.ja: 不透明でつやの無い平らな色。入りと抜きが細く、筆圧で幅が変わる。
description.en: Flat, matte, opaque color, thin at entry and release, with width changing under pressure.

physical_description.ja: 水で溶いた透ける色が紙にしみ、重なると濃くなり、縁に色が溜まる。
physical_description.en: Transparent water-thinned color soaks into the paper, deepens where it overlaps, and pools at the edges.

description.ja: 透ける色を重ね、重なると濃くなる。縁の内側に色が溜まり、作品のほかの色が少し混ざる。
description.en: Layers transparent color that deepens where it overlaps and pools inside the edge, taking in a little of the work's other colors.

physical_description.ja: 油で練った絵具を厚く塗り重ね、刷毛筋と盛り上がり、つやのある重なりが残る。
physical_description.en: Oil-bound paint laid on thickly, with bristle ridges, raised impasto, and glossy overlapping strokes.

description.ja: 厚みのある色層と筆筋を重ね、一部の運びに作品のほかの色の筋が混ざる。
description.en: Layers a dense paint body with visible brush streaks; some strokes carry thin streaks of the work's other colors.

words.surface_ja: ペインティングナイフ

physical_description.ja: ナイフで盛って伸ばした絵具の平らな面に、稜と縁、かすれが残る。
physical_description.en: Paint heaped and spread with a knife into flat planes, leaving ridges, edges, and dry streaks.

description.ja: ナイフの一引きで絵具を平らに盛って伸ばし、稜と影、かすれて割れる終わりを残す。ほかの色が面に混ざることもある。
description.en: Each pull of the knife heaps paint and spreads it flat, leaving a ridge with its shadow and an end that breaks into dry streaks; other colors may mix into a plane.

physical_description.ja: 酸で腐食させた太さのそろった線に、わずかな荒れと丸い端が残り、線の重ねで陰を作る。
physical_description.en: Acid-bitten lines of even width with slightly rough edges and round ends; shading is built by layering lines.

description.ja: 太さのそろった線に、腐食の細かな荒れと丸い端。面は向きを変えた細い平行線で陰を作る。
description.en: Lines of even width with finely bitten edges and round ends; surfaces build shade from fine parallel lines at varied angles.

physical_description.ja: 方眼の升を並べた線と、升の点描に明るい走査線を重ねた塗り。
physical_description.en: Lines built from grid cells, and fills of dithered cells under light scan lines.

description.ja: 方眼の升を並べて線を描く。塗りは升の点描に明るい走査線を重ねる。線と輪郭は太さを変えても升の大きさが同じで、濃い・薄いは効かない。
description.en: Draws lines as rows of grid squares; a fill is a dither of squares under bright scan lines. Lines and outlines keep the same square size at any width, and dense and faint do not apply to them.

description.ja: 切れ目のない線で描く。書かない時と同じ。
description.en: Draws an unbroken line, the same as writing no continuity.

description.ja: 短い線分を、間を空けて並べて引く。線と自由線に効き、弧と閉じた形には効かない。
description.en: Draws short segments with gaps between them. On lines and free lines; not on arcs or closed shapes.

description.ja: 点を連ねて引く。線と自由線に効き、弧と閉じた形には効かない。
description.en: Draws a run of dots. On lines and free lines; not on arcs or closed shapes.

description.ja: 面には何も置かず、輪郭を残す。
description.en: Leaves the face untouched, keeping the contour.

description.ja: 閉じた形の面を一様に塗る。線・弧・自由線には効かない。
description.en: Fills the face of a closed shape evenly. Not on lines, arcs or free lines.

description.ja: 少し向きを変えて、面を二度掃く。一度の掃きは、帯が溶け合った一枚の淡い膜になる。薄いを添えるとさらに淡くなる。線や弧では幅広い帯になる。
description.en: Sweeps the face twice at slightly different angles; each sweep is one pale film of merged bands. Faint makes it paler. On a line or arc it makes a broad band.

description.ja: 刷きと同じ帯を、溶け合わせずに一本ずつ重ねる。帯の重なった所が段をなして濃くなる。閉じた形の面に効く。
description.en: Lays the bands of a sweep one by one without merging them, so overlaps darken in steps. On the face of a closed shape.

description.ja: 一方に流れる細かな粒が、紙の歯で途切れた面を作る。線や弧では、線のかすれが増える。
description.en: Makes a face of fine grain streaming one way, broken by the paper's tooth. On a line or arc it adds skips to the stroke.

description.ja: 同じ大きさの丸い点を置き、点の数で、左上の明るい側から右下の暗い側へ調子を傾ける。閉じた形の面に効く。
description.en: Lays round dots of one size, more of them toward the lower right, so the tone runs from a light upper left to a dark lower right. On the face of a closed shape.

description.ja: 平行な細い線で面を埋める。閉じた形の面に効く。
description.en: Fills the face with fine parallel lines. On the face of a closed shape.

description.ja: 平行線に、向きを変えたもう一組を重ねる。閉じた形の面に効く。
description.en: Lays a second set of parallel lines across the first at another angle. On the face of a closed shape.

description.ja: 深い調子の面に、紙の白が細かな点でのぞき、左上が磨き出したように明るむ。閉じた形の面に効く。「メゾチント。」だけの文は、じの語になる。
description.en: A deep-toned face where the paper shows through in fine specks, lightening toward the upper left as if burnished. On the face of a closed shape. A sentence of mezzotint alone is the ground word.

description.ja: 道具の本来の濃さより濃く置く。線・弧・質感の面・塗りに効き、デジタルの線と輪郭には効かない。図は左が程よい鉛筆の点描、右が濃い点描。
description.en: Lays ink or paint more densely relative to the tool, on lines, arcs, textured faces or flat fills; not on digital lines and outlines. Left: moderate pencil stipple; right: dense stipple.

description.ja: 道具の本来の濃さで置く。さばきを省略した痕と同じ。図は左右とも程よい鉛筆の点描。
description.en: Lays ink or paint at the tool's own opacity, as when handling is omitted. Both halves show moderate pencil stipple.

description.ja: 道具の本来の濃さより淡く置く。線・弧・質感の面・塗りに効き、デジタルの線と輪郭には効かない。図は左が程よい鉛筆の点描、右が薄い点描。
description.en: Lays ink or paint more faintly relative to the tool, on lines, arcs, textured faces or flat fills; not on digital lines and outlines. Left: moderate pencil stipple; right: faint stipple.

description.ja: 痕の縁の外へ、同じ色の淡いにじみを不ぞろいに広げる。痕の形は変えない。
description.en: Spreads a pale, uneven halo of the same color beyond the mark's edge, without changing the mark's shape.

description.ja: 質感の点や線を小さくし、その分だけ数を増やす（覆う広さは変えない）。閉じた形の質感の面に添えられる。図は左が既定の点描、右が細かい点描。
description.en: Makes a texture's dots or lines smaller and lays more of them, covering the same area. On the textured face of a closed shape. Left: default stipple; right: fine-grained stipple.

description.ja: 質感の点や線を大きくし、その分だけ数を減らす（覆う広さは変えない）。閉じた形の質感の面に添えられる。図は左が既定の点描、右が粗い点描。
description.en: Makes a texture's dots or lines larger and lays fewer of them, covering the same area. On the textured face of a closed shape. Left: default stipple; right: coarse-grained stipple.

description.ja: 質感の点や線を詰めて、数を増やして置く。閉じた形の質感の面に添えられる。図は左が既定の点描、右が密な点描。
description.en: Lays a texture's dots or lines closer together, more of them. On the textured face of a closed shape. Left: default stipple; right: packed stipple.

description.ja: 質感の点や線の間を空けて、数を減らして置く。閉じた形の質感の面に添えられる。図は左が既定の点描、右が疎な点描。
description.en: Lays a texture's dots or lines farther apart, fewer of them. On the textured face of a closed shape. Left: default stipple; right: sparse stipple.

description.ja: 質感の下に画材の色を塗り、質感を塗りと逆の明るさで重ねる。閉じた形の質感の面に添えられる。図は左が既定の点描、右が下塗りの点描。
description.en: Paints the tool's colour under a texture and lays the texture over it in the opposite lightness. On the textured face of a closed shape. Left: default stipple; right: underpainted stipple.

description.ja: 地を無地の紙にする。細かな繊維の点がうっすら見える。
description.en: Makes the ground plain paper, with faint specks of fiber.

description.ja: 地を和紙にする。簀の目の細い筋と長い繊維が見える。描いた痕はにじみやすく、かすれにくい。
description.en: Makes the ground washi, with fine laid lines and long fibers. Marks on it spread more and skip less.

description.ja: 地を薄墨で淡く染め、一方に流れる墨のむらを置く。背景の色は透けて残る。描いた痕は少しにじみやすい。
description.en: Tints the ground with a pale ink wash, with pooled streaks running one way; the background color shows through. Marks on it spread a little more.

description.ja: 地を木炭で擦った濃い灰にし、一方に流れる擦れを残す。背景の色は隠れる。描いた線はかすれやすく、にじみにくい。
description.en: Makes the ground a dark gray rubbed with charcoal, with smudges running one way; it hides the background color. Lines on it skip more and spread less.

description.ja: 地を平織りの布目にする。描いた痕は、じの中でいちばんかすれやすく、にじみにくい。
description.en: Makes the ground a plain-woven canvas. Marks on it skip the most of any ground and spread less.

description.ja: 地を画用紙にする。細かな粒が見え、描いた線は少しかすれやすい。
description.en: Makes the ground drawing paper, with fine grain. Lines on it skip a little more.

description.ja: 地を黒に近い版にし、磨いて明るんだ所と、目立ての跡を置く。背景の色は隠れ、色を書かない痕は白で描かれる。「メゾチント。」だけの文で、じの語になる。
description.en: Makes the ground a near-black plate with burnished light patches and rocker marks; it hides the background color, and marks with no color written are drawn in white. Mezzotint alone in a sentence is this ground word.

description.ja: 白系の色で描く。
description.en: Draws in a white tone.

description.ja: 黒で描く。
description.en: Draws in black.

description.ja: 青系の色で描く。
description.en: Draws in a blue tone.

description.ja: 赤系の色で描く。
description.en: Draws in a red tone.

description.ja: 緑系の色で描く。
description.en: Draws in a green tone.

description.ja: 灰色で描く。
description.en: Draws in gray.

description.ja: 黄色系の色で描く。
description.en: Draws in a yellow tone.

description.ja: 橙色系の色で描く。
description.en: Draws in an orange tone.

description.ja: 紫系の色で描く。
description.en: Draws in a purple tone.

description.ja: 揺れの振れ幅を小さくする。揺れる・波打つと一緒に書く。
description.en: Makes the sway narrow. Written with swaying or undulating.

description.ja: 揺れの振れ幅を大きくする。揺れる・波打つと一緒に書く。
description.en: Makes the sway broad. Written with swaying or undulating.

description.ja: 揺れの間隔を長くする（痕の端から端までに二度ほどうねる）。振れ幅も少し大きくなる。
description.en: Lengthens the sway's interval, to about two swells along the whole mark, and widens it a little.

description.ja: 揺れの間隔を短くする（痕の端から端までに十数回振れる）。振れ幅は少し小さくなる。
description.en: Shortens the sway's interval, to a dozen or more swings along the whole mark, and narrows it a little.

description.ja: 線や輪郭を、不規則に揺らす。線と弧の端は動かさない。点には効かない。
description.en: Sways lines and outlines irregularly, keeping the ends of lines and arcs in place. Not on points.

description.ja: 線や輪郭を、規則的な波でうねらせる。線と弧の端は動かさない。点には効かない。
description.en: Makes lines and outlines undulate in a regular wave, keeping the ends of lines and arcs in place. Not on points.

description.ja: 画面の上の 3 分の 1 に置く。
description.en: Places it in the top third of the frame.

description.ja: 画面の下の 3 分の 1 に置く。
description.en: Places it in the bottom third of the frame.

description.ja: 画面の中央（縦横とも 3 分の 1〜3 分の 2）に置く。
description.en: Places it in the middle of the frame, a third to two thirds across and down.

description.ja: 画面の左の縁から幅 10 分の 1 の帯に寄せる。
description.en: Pulls it into the strip a tenth of the width from the left edge.

description.ja: 画面の右の縁から幅 10 分の 1 の帯に寄せる。
description.en: Pulls it into the strip a tenth of the width from the right edge.

description.ja: 画面の上の縁から高さ 10 分の 1 の帯に寄せる。
description.en: Pulls it into the strip a tenth of the height from the top edge.

description.ja: 画面の下の縁から高さ 10 分の 1 の帯に寄せる。
description.en: Pulls it into the strip a tenth of the height from the bottom edge.

description.ja: 四隅のどれかの、縦横 5 分の 1 の範囲に置く。
description.en: Places it in one of the four corners, within a fifth of the frame each way.

description.ja: 書いた場所に一つ置く。場所を書かなければ画面の中央に置く。
description.en: Places one at the given place, or at the middle of the frame when no place is written.

description.ja: 図形や組を列として並べる。
description.en: Lines shapes or groups up as a row.

description.ja: 線や弧を描く動作。
description.en: The act of drawing a line or an arc.

description.ja: 範囲の中に、ばらばらに散らす。数を書かなければ 8 個。
description.en: Scatters them irregularly within the range; eight when no count is written.

description.ja: 範囲を形で埋める。数は、範囲の広さと形の大きさから決まる。
description.en: Fills the range with the form; the count follows from the range's area and the form's size.

description.ja: 範囲の左上から、縦横の格子に並べる。書いた数と大きさを保つ。数を書かなければ 8 個。
description.en: Places them on a grid from the range's top left, keeping the written count and size; eight when no count is written.

description.ja: 二つの色や図形、組などを交互に繰り返す。組は一つとして数える。
description.en: Alternates two colors, shapes, or groups. Each group counts as one.

description.ja: 記述した色や図形、組などの順を保って繰り返す。
description.en: Repeats colors, shapes, or groups in the written order.

description.ja: 縦に長い形にする（長い辺と短い辺は 2:1）。
description.en: Makes the form tall, 2:1 long side to short.

description.ja: 横に長い形にする（長い辺と短い辺は 2:1）。
description.en: Makes the form wide, 2:1 long side to short.

description.ja: 画面幅いっぱいに広げる。
description.en: Spreads across the full width of the frame.

description.ja: 画面の半分程度の幅にする。
description.en: Sets the width to about half the frame.

description.ja: 線と輪郭の幅を、道具の普通の幅の約 3 分の 1 にする。
description.en: Makes lines and outlines about a third of the tool's normal width.

description.ja: 線と輪郭の幅を、道具の普通の幅の 6 割にする。
description.en: Makes lines and outlines 0.6 of the tool's normal width.

description.ja: 線と輪郭を、道具ごとに決めた太い幅にする（ペンでは普通の約 1.8 倍）。
description.en: Makes lines and outlines the thick width set for each tool (about 1.8 times normal for the pen).

description.ja: 線と輪郭を、道具ごとに決めたいちばん太い幅にする（ペンでは普通の 3 倍）。
description.en: Makes lines and outlines the widest width set for each tool (three times normal for the pen).

description.ja: 形を普通の大きさの 8 分の 3 にする。
description.en: Makes the form 3/8 of the normal size.

description.ja: 形を普通の大きさの半分にする。
description.en: Makes the form half the normal size.

description.ja: 普通の大きさで描く。円なら直径が画面の短い辺の約 4 分の 1。大きさを書かない時と同じ。
description.en: Draws the form at its normal size: a circle about a quarter of the frame's short side across. The same as writing no size.

description.ja: 形を普通の大きさの 1.5 倍にする。
description.en: Makes the form 1.5 times the normal size.

description.ja: 形を普通の大きさの 1.75 倍にする。
description.en: Makes the form 1.75 times the normal size.

description.ja: 直前の線を参照する関係。
description.en: A relation that refers to the preceding line.

description.ja: 直前の形に接触しない関係。
description.en: A relation that makes no contact with the preceding shape.

literals_ja: 前の弧に両端で触れる
literals_en: touching the previous arc at both ends

description.ja: 直前の形に接触する関係。
description.en: A relation that makes contact with the preceding shape.

description.ja: 直前の線を横切る関係。
description.en: A relation that crosses the preceding line.

description.ja: 直前の二つの要素の間に置く関係。
description.en: A relation that places between the two preceding elements.

description.ja: 線・弧・自由線・点の始点を、前の形の終点（閉じた形なら輪郭のいちばん近い所）へ動かしてつなぐ。「始点」「終点」「途中」を添えると、つなぐ所を選べる。
description.en: Moves the start of a line, arc, free line or point onto the end of the previous form (for a closed shape, the nearest point of its outline). Start, end or partway picks where it joins.

description.ja: 直前の形の上の縁に、下端を接して載せる関係。
description.en: A relation that rests the shape's lower edge on the top of the preceding shape.

description.ja: 直前の閉じた形の内側に置く関係。
description.en: A relation that places the shape inside the preceding closed shape.

description.ja: 直前の形に一部を重ねて置く関係。
description.en: A relation that overlaps part of the preceding shape.

description.ja: 直前の形を、片方の縁から反対の縁まで越えて置く関係。
description.en: A relation that crosses the preceding shape from one edge past the other.

description.ja: 二つの形の間の軸を挟んで、前の形の向きを鏡に映したように写す。同じ種類の形どうしにだけ効く。
description.en: Mirrors the previous form's orientation across the axis between the two. Only between forms of the same kind.
